structured.name: Expose: Advanced Web Research
structured.notes: General web research. Returns a markdown research report; requested CSV/JSON comes in a fenced code block. ~5 min per job (spike 2026-10-30). Input above 500 chars per text field makes start_job fail (Core 422), limit not declared in its form (measured 2026-10-30: 500 ok, 544 fails); additional_context limit assumed the same.

data.description:
# Advanced Web Research Agent

Conduct comprehensive web research using AI-powered analysis.

This agent answers open-ended questions by decomposing topics into one or more research steps, exploring the web, gathering sources, synthesizing findings, and returning detailed reports with citations.

**To get optimal results:** Do not just post a keyword, but formulate an actual open-ended question you want answered.

data.placeholder: Example: What are the key factors driving electric vehicle adoption in Europe?
Example: Focus on enterprise solutions, emphasize cost comparisons, include regulatory considerations...

image.name: Local stand-in image Agent (mock)
image.notes: Offline stand-in, hired only with QA_HIRE_BACKEND=mock. Composes one PNG/JPEG/WebP poster from rendered text plus COCO photos. Objects it can show: cat, couch, remote control, television, chair, potted plant, person, bear, bed, book, mirror, stop sign, tree, teddy bear, ski, refrigerator, oven, baseball glove, helmet, tennis racket.
